says: Ordaen Map's sea under the stitched zones: the deep ocean over the whole world, the shallow shelf round each continent, the ripples for close zoom.
origin: Made on 2026-11-21 by minimap-lab's tools/zone-art/sea-layers.ps1 (findings/zone-art.md) from FLUX.1 [schnell] pictures (workflow flux-schnell, 1536x1024): seaDeep from seed 52 and seaRipples from seed 51, prompt «aerial photograph straight down at calm deep open ocean water surface, gentle uniform swells and ripples, soft even daylight, deep teal blue, endless water filling the whole frame»; seaDeep its luminance smoothed and mapped between (52, 74, 84) and (84, 108, 106), seaRipples made seamless and its luminance about the mean in (84, 108, 106). seaShelf from OpenMap's land masks (media/openmap/land), grown 5 px and blurred twice by 16 px in a square twice the continent's size, in (128, 134, 112). The files are the source.
